question: How does this approach compares to the state-of-the-art results on these tasks?
title: Contextual Joint Factor Acoustic Embeddings
answer_short: The CJFA encoder performs significantly better than the VAE baseline and CJFS encoder in both phone classification and speaker recognition tasks, with gains of up to 3% on phone classification and 3–6% on speaker recognition.
answer_rationale: Text 2 explicitly states that the CJFA encoder performs significantly better than the other two approaches (VAE baseline and CJFS encoder) in both phone classification and speaker recognition tasks, with relative improvements of up to 3% on phone classification and 3–6% on speaker recognition. Text 1 corroborates that CJFA outperforms both the VAE baseline and CJFS encoder on both tasks. Text 4 and Text 8 further support these findings by noting CJFA’s superior performance and additional gains from out-of-domain data.
